# Final Announcement of National Fuel Gas Distribution Corporation Fall 2026 Marketer/Supplier Teleconference


#### October 19, 2026


Announcement of National Fuel Gas Distribution Corporation Marketer/Supplier Teleconference


Teleconference Date: **Tuesday, October 20, 2026** at **1:30 P.M. ET**


[Fall 2026 Presentation](https://www.nationalfuel.com/wp-content/uploads/documents/Fall-2026-Presentation.pdf)


Please be advised that National Fuel Gas Distribution Corporation (NFGDC) will host a Marketer/Supplier teleconference on Tuesday, October 20, 2026. **The Marketer/Supplier teleconference will begin at 1:30 P.M. ET.**


Presentation materials for this Marketer/Supplier teleconference are attached to this email for your reference. In addition, these materials are posted on the News and Announcements section of the Business Partners, Transportation Services web page at:[https://www.nationalfuel.com/business-partners/news-and-announcements/](https://www.nationalfuel.com/business-partners/news-and-announcements/)
